module_summary: Gshare branch predictor: 7-bit global history XOR pc indexes a 128-entry 2-bit saturating-counter PHT, with separate predict and train ports.

anchors.name: pht
anchors.why: 128-entry table of 2-bit saturating counters, read for prediction, updated on training.

anchors.name: predict_history_r
anchors.why: Global history shift register; shifts in predictions, restored from train_history on misprediction.

anchors.name: predict_valid
anchors.why: Prediction request; gates outputs and shifts predicted direction into history.

anchors.name: predict_taken
anchors.why: Predicted direction: MSB of PHT counter at predict_index.

anchors.name: train_valid
anchors.why: Training request; enables PHT counter update and history recovery.

anchors.name: predict_index
anchors.why: History XOR predict_pc hash addressing the PHT read.

anchors.name: train_index
anchors.why: train_history XOR train_pc hash selecting the PHT entry to update.

anchors.name: predict_pc
anchors.why: Branch pc hashed with global history to form prediction index.

anchors.name: train_pc
anchors.why: Trained branch pc hashed with train_history into train_index.

anchors.name: train_taken
anchors.why: Actual outcome; increments or decrements PHT counter and feeds history recovery.

anchors.name: train_mispredicted
anchors.why: Triggers history register recovery, overriding prediction-side history update.

anchors.name: train_history
anchors.why: History snapshot of trained branch; hashed into train_index and restores history.

groups.name: pattern_history_table
groups.description: PHT of saturating counters updated at train_index when train_valid.

groups.name: prediction_path
groups.description: Hash pc with history, read PHT counter MSB as predicted direction.

groups.name: global_history
groups.description: Global history register shifted on prediction, recovered on mispredicted training.
